svg.title: Every request is a round trip
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map. One dirt road runs from Your app on the left past seven wooden stations, numbered in order: Gate, Router, Cache, Vault, Customs, Post office, Ledger. Each station sits a little way off the road at the end of a short side road. Only after the last station does the road split into four roads (OCR, Messages, Responses, Chat) that tunnel through a hill to the model providers. Horse wagons carry requests along the road and up a side road.
svg.text: Every request is a round trip
Every request rides one road through all seven stations, then splits onto its API's road to the provider.
